name: Unauthorized Chemical Setpoint Alteration Response
description: Deterministic response procedure for unauthorized Modbus write commands altering process setpoints. Protects water safety without tripping plant intake.
recommended_recovery_action: Verify physical gauge, lock PLC memory keyswitch, isolate rogue conduit, and restore setpoint via authorized HMI.
non_disruption_guarantee: This playbook does not drop plant breakers or interrupt continuous potable water delivery.

steps.title: Physical Process Verification
steps.description: Dispatch field technician to inspect physical colorimetric chlorine analyzer dial on Disinfection Basin 1. Do NOT rely solely on remote SCADA display.
steps.safety_warning: Wear standard PPE (chlorine vapor respirator) when inspecting chemical dosing room.
steps.verification_check: Physical dial reading recorded and cross-referenced with SCADA.

steps.title: Hardware Memory Protect Key Switch
steps.description: Turn physical hardware key switch on PLC-01 chassis from 'REMOTE' to 'RUN / MEMORY PROTECT'. This physically disables network write commands at the hardware backplane.
steps.safety_warning: Ensure key is not switched to 'STOP' which would trip the intake pumps.
steps.verification_check: PLC front panel LED shows 'MEM PROT' lit solid.

steps.title: Isolate Unauthorized Engineering Conduit
steps.description: Instruct industrial firewall IFW-01 to sever conduit from Rogue Host (192.168.1.99) to PLC-01. Maintain Conduit C-101 (HMI to PLC) active to preserve process visibility.
steps.safety_warning: Do NOT disconnect the entire plant switch; isolate only the rogue IP MAC pairing.
steps.verification_check: Firewall logs confirm drops from 192.168.1.99; HMI polling remains continuous.

steps.title: Authorized Setpoint Restoration
steps.description: From primary supervisory HMI-01, issue authorized write command to restore Register 1004 (Chlorine Setpoint) to 2.0 PPM.
steps.verification_check: Holding register 1004 confirmed at 2.0 PPM; dosing rate stabilizes.
